19038.desc:
December costume calendars run on outfits like this: a bandeau top, a holiday-themed piece, and headgear, all in chiffon and cut to the colorway shown. It is the kind of set that solves a themed night in one purchase.

Chiffon is the right call for this genre - light enough for indoor wear, sheer enough to keep it in lingerie territory rather than costume rental. The bandeau stays put without straps, and the headgear carries the Christmas cue so the outfit does not have to shout it everywhere else.

  • Material: chiffon
  • Includes: clothes, headgear, thong
  • Style: Christmas uniform set
  • Color: as pictured
  • Sizing: one size, recommended 40-60 kg

Chiffon stores small: the whole set folds into a drawer corner and reappears next December none the worse. Between the headgear and the thong, count five seconds for dressing - the bandeau does not need adjusting once it is on.

Fits 40-60 kg. Pull it out the week between Christmas and New Year, when every party has a theme.
19038.short: Chiffon Christmas uniform set with bandeau top, headgear and matching thong, as pictured, one size for 40-60 kg holiday wear.
19038.tkd_desc: Chiffon Christmas costume set with bandeau top, headgear and thong, as pictured. One size for 40-60 kg, holiday role-play ready.

19045.desc:
The bunny girl silhouette works because it is a uniform stripped to three signals: the ears, the fitted body, and the accessories. This chiffon version gets all three - a top, a thong, a bracelet, and a leg ring in the colorway shown.

Chiffon keeps the set light and slightly sheer, closer to lingerie than to costume satin, which suits private wear better than a party hall. The bracelet and leg ring are small pieces with outsized effect; they break up the silhouette and give the camera something to catch.

  • Material: chiffon
  • Includes: top, thong, bracelet, leg ring
  • Style: bunny girl uniform
  • Color: as pictured
  • Sizing: one size, recommended 40-60 kg

Stockings are the natural extension - sheer black or white depending on the colorway, held by the leg ring that arrives in the bag. The bracelet mirrors the neck line and gives a camera something to catch at wrist height.

One size across 40-60 kg. Add stockings if the look needs more coverage, leave them off if it does not.
19045.short: Chiffon bunny girl uniform set with top, thong, bracelet and leg ring, one size for 40-60 kg, four lingerie-weight pieces.
19045.tkd_title: Bunny Girl Uniform Set, 4 Pieces | RoseToys
19045.tkd_desc: Chiffon bunny girl set with top, thong, bracelet and leg ring, as pictured. One size for 40-60 kg, four-piece lingerie uniform.

19053.desc:
A cheongsam-style swimsuit in polyester with cut-outs: one-piece bodysuit in black or white, S and M by weight. S fits 85-105 lbs, M fits 105-120 lbs.

The elastic-fit construction suits swimwear use, and the cut-out placement borrows the cheongsam silhouette - collar line, side interest - in a swimsuit format. Two colorways, both as pictured.

  • Material: polyester, elastic
  • Item type: one-piece bodysuit
  • Style: cheongsam swimsuit, cut-out
  • Color: black or white
  • Sizing: S (85-105 lbs), M (105-120 lbs)

S and M by weight band with an elastic-fit construction that tolerates actual water - the cheongsam silhouette in swimsuit form is a crossover that works precisely because the fabric is swim-grade rather than costume-grade.

Order by weight. The oriental-silhouette swim option that works as costume or as a suit.

Two sizes by weight rather than one-size optimism, and the elastic fit means the S-M split lands where it should rather than where a chart hopes - measure once, order once, wear it either way.
19053.short: Cheongsam-style cut-out swimsuit in black or white with elastic fit, S and M for 85-120 lbs, oriental-silhouette one-piece. Measure once, order once, and wear it as costume or suit.
19053.tkd_desc: Elastic polyester swimsuit with cheongsam-style cut-outs in black or white. S for 85-105 lbs and M for 105-120 lbs, one-piece.

19055.desc:
Five pieces make this maid set read as a costume rather than a lingerie set: headgear, neck ring, bra, thong, and the apron that does the actual work of saying maid. Chiffon throughout, in the colorway shown.

The apron is the anchor. Over a bra and thong it creates the servant silhouette from the front while leaving the back mostly bare - a structural trick heavier fabrics cannot pull off. The neck ring adds the formality that separates maid from generic lingerie, and the headgear finishes it.

  • Material: chiffon
  • Includes: headgear, neck ring, bra, thong, apron
  • Style: maid servant, midnight glamour
  • Color: as pictured
  • Sizing: one size, recommended 40-60 kg

The apron ties at both the waist and the neck in the classic construction, so the fit adjusts across the one-size range rather than assuming one shape. Undo the neck tie and the front panel drops - a design feature, not a flaw.

Sized 40-60 kg. Wear it as a complete costume or drop the headgear and neck ring for a simpler bedroom set.
19055.short: Five-piece chiffon maid servant set with apron, headgear, neck ring, bra and thong, one size for 40-60 kg, midnight glamour styling.

19055.tkd_desc: Chiffon maid servant costume with apron, headgear, neck ring, bra and thong. Five pieces, one size for 40-60 kg, as pictured.

19065.desc:
A single-piece answer to the cat costume question: one chiffon jumpsuit, as pictured, with an open-crotch cut that removes the wardrobe break entirely. The fabric is light and slightly sheer, closer to a bodysuit than a suit.

As a Catwoman reference it works because it commits to one shape - fitted, full-length, no extra pieces to lose. The open construction is the functional detail; everything else is the silhouette doing the work.

  • Material: chiffon
  • Item type: jumpsuit
  • Style: Catwoman, open crotch
  • Color: as pictured
  • Sizing: one size, recommended 40-60 kg

Chiffon bodysuits run best hand-washed in cold water and hung to dry - machine agitation is what shortens their life. The open construction means no fastenings to fuss with; it is on or it is off, and nothing in between needs managing.

Fits 40-60 kg. Add ears and a mask from your own drawer and the costume is done, or wear it plain as a bedroom bodysuit.
19065.short: Chiffon Catwoman jumpsuit with built-in open-crotch cut, one size for 40-60 kg, single-piece costume in as-pictured colorway, Fitted full-length line with no extra pieces to lose anywhere.
19065.tkd_desc: Open-crotch chiffon jumpsuit in Catwoman styling, as pictured. One size for 40-60 kg, single-piece costume lingerie with fitted line.

19109.desc:
A bride costume distilled to lace mesh: a top, a skirt, and a veil, in the colorway shown. The fabric is sheer where it can be and structured where it has to be, which is the whole engineering problem of bridal lingerie solved in three pieces.

The veil sets the role at a glance - without it this is a mesh lingerie set, with it the bride theme lands before anyone reads the silhouette. The skirt keeps movement in the outfit, and the top does the shaping.

  • Material: lace mesh
  • Includes: top, skirt, veil
  • Style: bride role-play
  • Color: as pictured
  • Sizing: one size, 40-60 kg

The veil is the piece that photographs - it catches light and movement in a way the mesh itself does not. Breeze, a fan, or a doorway turn are all it takes. Between uses, flat storage keeps the lace from creasing along the mesh lines.

Best fit 40-60 kg. A wedding-night classic that also serves any costume occasion needing a white-theme outfit in one buy.
19109.short: Sheer mesh bride set with top, skirt and veil for role-play occasions, one size fitting 40-60 kg, as pictured in lace.
19109.tkd_title: Sheer Mesh Bride Role-Play Set | RoseToys
19109.tkd_desc: Sheer lace mesh bride set with top, skirt and veil, as pictured. One size for 40-60 kg, three-piece role-play costume.

19157.desc:
An anime-queen take on costume lingerie: a full patent leather jumpsuit in black, fronted by a zipper that runs the length of the outfit. The shine is the design - patent leather under party light does what printed fabric cannot.

The cut is one-piece with a fitted line through the torso, sized 90-155 lbs in a single size. The zipper is functional rather than decorative, which changes how the costume is worn: closed for the entrance, and however you like after.

  • Material: patent leather
  • Item type: jumpsuit
  • Style: anime queen, full front zipper
  • Color: black
  • Sizing: one size, 90-155 lbs

Patent leather jumpsuits want a wipe-down after wear and storage away from direct heat - radiators and car dashboards are the two usual culprits. The zipper runs smoother with an occasional dry-lube if it stiffens after a season in storage.

Wipe-clean surface, no ironing questions. Fits 90-155 lbs with stretch through the shoulders.

19185.desc:

Sizing is by weight, and this set is one of the few in the costume line with a genuine three-size run: S for 40-55 kg, M for 50-60 kg, L for 55-65 kg. Overlap is intentional; pick the closer fit for a sharper silhouette.

  • Material: patent leather
  • Includes: top, skirt, tie
  • Style: policewoman
  • Color: black
  • Sizing: S (40-55 kg), M (50-60 kg), L (55-65 kg)

Three sizes rather than one is the practical argument for this listing over the one-size police sets: patent leather shows a wrong fit immediately, and the tie adjusts only so far. Order the closer band if you sit between two.

The patent finish wipes clean and holds its shine without maintenance - an advantage fabric police costumes never offer.
